title: Share native reflex vocabulary and projection without external dependencies
goal: Vision: V-2. Preserve exact public vectors, checkpoint provenance, core-only training, registered actions, inference and all fallback behavior while consolidating canonical vocabulary and allocation-free per-word accumulation.

reuse.searched: Existing GEMI public reflex feature and centroid functions, trained-checkpoint readers/writers, capability checks, memory-store cosine scoring and ABI FNV widths. Reused one exact ordered native vocabulary for both APIs; the separate package experiment did not reduce the complete linked core.
